$Comment: The T2 find table, top floor of band A (score 100, where a committed woodcutter with most of a skill tree claimed lands). One byproduct pull plus the first life essence: a one-in-four chance of 3 to 5, richer than the jar's own second tier because reaching this one cost a luck investment. Offcuts come from RPG Stations' own shared RPG_Station_Sawmill_Byproducts list, referenced by id through a Droplist container rather than listed here, so retuning what milling yields is one edit in that file and every tier in both mods moves together.
